mechanism: Both drugs impair renal function through different mechanisms (SGLT2 inhibitor-induced osmotic diuresis and bisphosphonate nephrotoxicity), increasing risk of acute kidney injury and reduced drug clearance.
action: Monitor renal function (eGFR and serum creatinine) closely before initiation and regularly during co-therapy; ensure adequate hydration with zoledronic acid infusion; consider alternative therapies if eGFR <30 mL/min/1.73m².
